Эта страница описывает техническое повед: This page describes the MVP's technical behavior. The full policy and operator details must be approved before public launch.
Платформа сохраняет email, имя, защищённ: The platform stores email, name, a secure password hash, prompts, generation history and uploaded images. Telegram sign-in stores a verified Telegram ID and name.
JWT хранится в HttpOnly cookie. Для созд: JWT is stored in an HttpOnly cookie. Prompts and source photos are sent to Higgsfield to create videos. Trend photos and generated videos are stored privately in Cloudflare R2 and accessed through temporary links. Standard generator images are stored in private local server storage.
Сроки хранения, юридические основания об: Retention periods, legal grounds for processing and data deletion procedures must be configured by the operator before launch.
Betelgeuse находится на стадии MVP. Это: Betelgeuse is an MVP. This is a preliminary description of the service; commercial and legal terms have not been published yet.
Используй только изображения и материалы: Only use images and materials you have the necessary rights to. Do not upload other people's confidential data. Generations are also subject to the provider's moderation rules.
Доступ к генерациям выдаётся администрат: An administrator grants generation access through quotas. Registration does not automatically include paid generations. Subscriptions and payments are unavailable in this version.
Результаты и время обработки зависят от: Results and processing time depend on a third-party API. Provider links expire; download videos you want to keep.
Контактный канал команды будет опубликов: The team's contact channel will be published before public launch.
Если ты тестируешь MVP по приглашению, и: If you are testing the MVP by invitation, contact the administrator who gave you access.
